title: How to Get CWB Certified in Canada: A Step-by-Step Guide for Welders
excerpt: CWB certification is the welding ticket Canadian shops ask for first. This guide covers the CSA standards, the three testing routes, the bend test, 2026 test costs and how to keep your ticket current.
seoTitle: CWB Certification in Canada: 2026 Welder Guide
seoDesc: How to get CWB certification in Canada: CSA W47.1 tickets, test routes, bend test, 2026 costs ($170–$185 per position) and renewal rules, step by step.
seoKeywords: CWB certification, CWB welding ticket, CSA W47.1, CWB test cost, how to get a welding ticket in Canada, CWB bend test, CWB renewal, CWB vs Red Seal
